_comment: System messages this server adds on top of the client's own table.
Ids start above the highest the retail table uses, so a client patch that
adds messages cannot collide with ours. `l2r-tools client-dat sync-messages`
appends these to SystemMsg*.dat with defaults for every column it does not
know about, which is what makes them display at all — a message id the
client has no row for renders as nothing.
Names follow the retail convention, and the C<n>/S<n> tokens in them are
what the generator reads to decide the constructor's arity: C is a name
(player/npc), S is anything else. Numbering is the parameter order the
packet carries, not the order they appear in the sentence.

messages.name: C1_HAS_RESISTED_S2_CHANCE_WAS_S3
messages.note: Single-target debuff that failed its landing roll. Replaces the hand-formatted string the resist path used to push through S1_TEXT.

messages.name: S1_LANDED_ON_C2_CHANCE_WAS_S3
messages.note: The success half of the same roll, so the caster sees the computed chance either way.
